metadata.title: Where Are Aligna’s Date and Numbering Options? | Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
Aligna’s rename presets include date-format and sequence-start options. The captured examples show yyyyMMdd and a starting number of 1.

Still screenshot guide using real Android emulator captures and demonstration files. No taps, edits, Apply operation, completed rename or speed demonstration is shown. The date example belongs to the capture, not the publication date. This is not a live recording, and the video has no audio.

Aligna for Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.aligna
